purpose: Deterministic offline regression corpus for Terraform HCL security findings and analysis completeness.

cases.notes: An explicitly public bucket produces S3-001; the current HCL model also reports missing TLS-enforcement policy evidence as S3-007.
A security group with no inbound rules is the secure/no-finding control case.
An unresolved security-group name must remain visible without unrelated S3 findings.
A remote module is not fetched implicitly and its skipped coverage must be reported.

notes: Fixtures are synthetic and contain no credentials or live cloud identifiers.

The initial corpus is a local regression benchmark, not a claim of differential parity. Upstream check-by-check adapters should be added only with pinned tool versions and reviewed output normalization.
